themes.name: hyperclass
themes.title: HYPERCLASS — Gilded Void
themes.description: First class aboard a starliner crossing the void: champagne brass on deep-space ink, ivory starlight, one vein of ice. A brass hairline round the focused window and an airlock-iris animation when it opens.
themes.author: blyatiful1

themes.name: magma
themes.title: MAGMA — Obsidian Flow
themes.description: Obsidian glass over a living magma chamber: ember orange, lava gold, one cool teal vein. Molten-glass blur, ember running dots and a slideshow of the chamber itself.
themes.author: blyatiful1

themes.name: netrunner
themes.title: NETRUNNER — Jack In
themes.description: A netrunner's deck in Night City: HUD cyan on desaturated navy void, one cyber-yellow signature per surface, Edgerunners hot-pink in the terminal's veins. Ships a live Night City wallpaper. Strictly border-free.
themes.author: blyatiful1

themes.name: nightbloom
themes.title: NIGHTBLOOM — the glasshouse after dark
themes.description: A Victorian glass conservatory at night: real glass panes over deep green dark, bioluminescent jade, and exactly one amber firefly on every surface. Rare violet grow-lights. Nothing pure black, no window borders.
themes.author: blyatiful1
